root_causes.title: autonomous_cycle.py does not read SAL output
root_causes.symptom: Sprint passes all gates with 0 workbench SAL facts for cited format
root_causes.root_cause: SAL pipeline is parallel/advisory; no integration with autonomous_cycle
root_causes.impact: Spec authority is advisory only; any gap_ledger_ref satisfies TC-GUARD-001 regardless of fact depth
root_causes.repair: At minimum: read sal-facts-latest.json in Step 1c; emit advisory per-format workbench_count warning

root_causes.title: SAL daily output generated in default mode — mixes template + workbench facts
root_causes.symptom: FODS daily SAL output has ~22 bootstrap_only template facts; GAP-INT-002 index includes them
root_causes.impact: GAP-INT-002 authority check weaker than intended; product sources can cite template-only fact IDs and pass
root_causes.repair: Switch daily SAL generation to from_cache_only=True

root_causes.title: GAP-INT-002 has no source==workbench_verified filter
root_causes.symptom: Template facts appear in SAL index; product source citations not filtered by authority
root_causes.root_cause: _load_sal_facts() does not filter on source field
root_causes.impact: Non-deterministic authority; if template facts change, product citations could break silently
root_causes.repair: Add filter: only include facts where fact.get('source') == 'workbench_verified'

root_causes.title: Gnumeric spec not acquired; no normalized text
root_causes.root_cause: Normalization pipeline never run for Gnumeric
root_causes.impact: 0 SAL workbench facts for Gnumeric; 36 gap entries cite no spec facts
root_causes.repair: Run normalization pipeline for Gnumeric XML schema

root_causes.title: ABW spec (DTD) unreachable
root_causes.impact: 0 SAL workbench facts for ABW; proof level P1
root_causes.repair: Identify alternative spec source or classify as BLOCKED_EXTERNAL

root_causes.title: Healing gate Lane 1 checks fods_facts_gte_10 not workbench_verified_fact_count > 0
root_causes.root_cause: Criterion was set when FODS had only 14 format-specific facts; now obsolete
root_causes.impact: Gate passes trivially; does not verify workbench authority depth
root_causes.repair: Add workbench_verified_fact_count_positive criterion to Lane 1

root_causes.title: No governed skills for spec acquisition chain for most formats
root_causes.root_cause: sal-pipeline-heal skill covers repair, not initial acquisition from external sources
root_causes.impact: Gnumeric/ABW/CSV spec acquisition cannot be governed or tracked repeatably
root_causes.repair: TC-0021: design spec acquisition skill

root_causes.title: No machine-generated proof graph
root_causes.root_cause: Spec stubs and QName registry are separate artifacts; no automated chain validation
root_causes.impact: P5 proof chain for FODS is assembled manually from separate artifacts; no single verifiable graph
root_causes.repair: Create generate_proof_graph.py

root_causes.title: Gap-ledger CSV entries reference FACT-CSV-001/002 not in SAL output

root_causes.impact: 58 CSV gaps appear spec-backed; TC-GUARD-001 accepts items citing these gaps
root_causes.repair: Clear spec_facts for all CSV gaps; or properly acquire CSV spec

root_causes.title: Gap-ledger has no authority_level field on any of 958 entries
root_causes.root_cause: Field was never added; spec-to-feature plan required it
root_causes.impact: TC-GUARD-001 cannot distinguish gap authority quality

root_causes.title: TC-GUARD-001 checks gap reference PRESENCE not AUTHORITY QUALITY
root_causes.root_cause: Step 2d3 checks presence only; no authority depth check
root_causes.impact: Gnumeric/ABW/CSV gaps satisfy guard identically to FODS gaps with 4987 facts
root_causes.repair: Add advisory depth check after presence check

root_causes.impact: Legacy items and new items without skills can pass without audit trail
